subject.title: fix(discord): retry stale preview cleanup after final delivery

question: Should failed `clearFinalizableDraftMessage` deletion retain the current draft ID as the permanent channel-outbound plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The implementation and proof support retained ownership as the safer invariant, but changing observable behavior of an exported plugin helper requires explicit owner intent rather than an automated merge decision.

options.title: Approve Retained Ownership
options.body: Accept failed-delete retention as the corrected SDK contract and merge after exact-head gates confirm the reviewed head.

options.title: Preserve Consume-on-Attempt
options.body: Keep the existing exported-helper behavior and implement Discord-specific retry bookkeeping behind the plugin boundary.

recommendation.title: Approve Retained Ownership
